sinopsis.es: Suet Ying Chung, ganadora del Caballo de Oro, y Wai Lun Yeung encabezan el sólido debut de Leung Chuen Yeung, donde una actriz en apuros y un exconvicto dueño de un restaurante convierten una disputa menor en un vínculo improbable. Ingenioso, conmovedor y accesible.
sinopsis.en: Golden Horse winner Suet Ying Chung and Wai Lun Yeung lead Leung Chuen Yeung’s assured debut, in which a struggling actress and an ex-con restaurant owner turn a petty dispute into an unlikely bond. Witty, moving, and accessible.
